name: Assam Entrade Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, Assam Entrade Ltd deals in share market and provides loans
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is registered as Non–Banking Financial Company without accepting public deposit, engaged in trading of shares & mutual funds, and provides intercorporate loans

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -4.12% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 3.10% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from 201 days to 350 days
